situations.title: {name} gets a pet-shop order
situations.body: A chain of pet shops wants robot pets in every store, bringing in a large order.

situations.title: Pet shops make room for {name}
situations.body: A pet-shop chain is adding robot pets to its shelves and has placed a large order.

situations.title: {name} lands a travel order
situations.body: A travel company wants space snacks in its meal packs, bringing in a large order.

situations.title: Travel packs add {name} snacks
situations.body: A travel company has ordered space snacks for its meal packs, giving the factory a big batch to make.

situations.title: {name} powers a delivery fleet
situations.body: A courier company has ordered super batteries for its delivery carts, adding a steady customer.

situations.title: Delivery carts pick {name} power
situations.body: A courier is fitting its carts with super batteries and has placed an order for the whole fleet.

situations.title: {name} wins a refill deal
situations.body: A cinema chain has chosen its fizzy drinks for refill stations, adding regular orders.

situations.title: Cinema refills bring business to {name}
situations.body: A cinema chain will use its fizzy drinks at refill stations, bringing in orders throughout the year.

situations.title: {name} signs a skate-park deal
situations.body: An indoor skate park will rent out its jet sneakers, paying for new pairs and regular servicing.

situations.title: Skate-park rentals choose {name}
situations.body: A skate park has signed a year-long deal to rent its jet sneakers and pay for upkeep.

situations.title: {name} signs an arcade deal
situations.body: An arcade chain will pay to offer its video games at every branch, bringing in regular fees.

situations.title: Arcade screens add {name} games
situations.body: An arcade chain has agreed to pay a yearly fee to put its video games on more screens.

situations.title: {name} makes pets easier to hold
situations.body: Smaller hand grips on its robot pets help younger players carry them, and stores are ordering more.

situations.title: New pet grips help {name} sell
situations.body: Its robot pets now have handles made for smaller hands. Shops say more families are choosing them.

situations.title: {name} finds a better fit
situations.body: New adjustable straps help more shoppers find jet sneakers that fit, and stores are ordering extra pairs.

situations.title: Better straps bring orders to {name}
situations.body: More shoppers can wear its jet sneakers with the new adjustable straps, so shops are stocking extra pairs.

situations.title: {name} adds a handy connector
situations.body: A new connector lets its super batteries fit more garden tools, opening up another group of buyers.

situations.title: More tools can use {name} batteries
situations.body: Its super batteries now come with a connector for several garden tools, helping it reach more customers.

situations.title: {name} launches a peach fizz
situations.body: A new peach fizzy drink is drawing shoppers to the shelves, and stores are placing opening orders.

situations.title: Peach fizz joins the {name} range
situations.body: Shops are ordering its new peach fizzy drink to give customers another flavour to try.

situations.title: {name} launches a crunchy snack
situations.body: Its new crunchy space snacks are ready for sale. Shops are ordering the first boxes for their shelves.

situations.title: A new crunch arrives from {name}
situations.body: Stores are taking their first deliveries of its new crunchy space snacks, adding another product to sell.

situations.title: {name} releases a puzzle game
situations.body: Its new video game lets players build floating mazes, and launch-day sales are bringing in money.

situations.title: Floating mazes arrive from {name}
situations.body: Players are buying its newly released maze-building game, giving the studio a fresh source of sales.

situations.title: {name} pets sell out at a fair
situations.body: A toy fair has sold all its robot pets. The stall holders are ordering more for the next weekend.

situations.title: Toy-fair stalls need more {name} pets
situations.body: Every robot pet at a toy fair has been bought, leaving sellers asking for another delivery.

situations.title: {name} empties the drinks shelves
situations.body: Shops have sold their fizzy-drink supplies earlier than expected and are placing extra orders.

situations.title: Shops call for more {name} fizz
situations.body: Its fizzy drinks have sold out in several shops, so the shops want a larger next delivery.

situations.title: {name} runs out of a popular size
situations.body: A popular size of jet sneakers has sold out. Shops are asking the company to make more pairs.

situations.title: Shoppers snap up {name} sneakers
situations.body: Stores have sold every pair in one popular size of jet sneakers and have ordered replacements.

situations.title: {name} wins a snack award
situations.body: Its space snacks won a taste award at a food fair. Shops want to stock the winning flavour.

situations.title: A taste prize puts {name} on shelves
situations.body: A food-fair prize for its space snacks is drawing shop owners to order the winning flavour.

situations.title: {name} wins a game-design prize
situations.body: A games festival gave its puzzle game a design prize, and more visitors are buying a copy.

situations.title: A festival prize brings sales to {name}
situations.body: Its video game won a prize for puzzle design. Players who saw it at the festival are buying it.

situations.title: {name} wins a battery-design award
situations.body: A tools fair gave its super batteries a design award. More tool shops are asking to stock them.

situations.title: Tool shops notice {name}'s award
situations.body: An award for its super-battery design is attracting orders from shops that sell garden tools.

situations.title: {name} speeds up pet assembly
situations.body: A new workbench lets workers fit robot-pet legs faster, so the factory can finish more pets each day.

situations.title: More pets leave the {name} workbench
situations.body: A better assembly bench speeds up fitting the robot pets' legs, letting the factory fill more orders.

situations.title: {name} speeds up bottle filling
situations.body: A new filling machine handles more fizzy-drink bottles each hour, helping the factory keep up with orders.

situations.title: More bottles roll through {name}'s factory
situations.body: A faster filling machine lets the factory pack more fizzy drinks into the same working day.

situations.title: {name} speeds up battery checks
situations.body: New testing racks check more super batteries at once, so finished orders can leave the factory sooner.

situations.title: Battery tests move faster at {name}
situations.body: Its factory can test several trays of super batteries together, clearing orders for delivery more quickly.

situations.title: {name} steps into more sports shops
situations.body: A sports-shop chain is adding its jet sneakers to stores that have never sold them, reaching new shoppers.

situations.title: More sports shops stock {name}
situations.body: Its jet sneakers are going into new branches of a sports-shop chain, giving more shoppers a place to try them.

situations.title: {name} reaches station shops
situations.body: Shops at busy train stations are starting to stock its space snacks, putting them in front of more travellers.

situations.title: Station shelves welcome {name}
situations.body: Its space snacks are arriving in train-station shops for the first time, reaching people buying food for a trip.

situations.title: {name} reaches another game store
situations.body: An online game store is adding its video games, giving the studio a new place to sell downloads.

situations.title: A new download shop lists {name}
situations.body: Its video games will appear in another online store, putting them in front of that store's regular shoppers.

situations.title: {name} cuts bottle waste
situations.body: A stronger crate keeps more fizzy-drink bottles intact during delivery, cutting the cost of replacing broken ones.

situations.title: Better crates protect {name} drinks
situations.body: Fewer fizzy-drink bottles break in its new delivery crates, so it spends less on replacements.

situations.title: {name} keeps snacks crisp for longer
situations.body: A better seal keeps its space snacks crisp for longer. Shops throw away fewer unsold packs and order more.

situations.title: Freshness seals help {name} snacks last
situations.body: Its new packet seal keeps space snacks crisp on the shelf, reducing waste for shops that stock them.

situations.title: {name} reuses battery packing trays
situations.body: Reusable trays protect its super batteries during delivery and return to the factory, saving packing costs.

situations.title: Returnable trays save money for {name}
situations.body: Its battery-delivery trays can be used again, so the company buys less new packing material.

situations.title: {name} owners come back for another pet
situations.body: Families who bought one robot pet are returning for a second, adding repeat sales for the company.

situations.title: Second pets bring sales to {name}
situations.body: Shops say robot-pet owners are buying another pet to join the first, bringing back customers.

situations.title: {name} wearers return for a new pair
situations.body: People who wore out their jet sneakers are choosing the same brand again, adding repeat orders.

situations.title: Old customers choose {name} again
situations.body: Shops say customers replacing worn-out jet sneakers are buying another pair from the same company.

situations.title: {name} players buy the next chapter
situations.body: Players who finished its adventure game are paying for the next chapter, bringing in more sales.

situations.title: Returning players support {name}
situations.body: More owners of its adventure game are buying the next chapter instead of moving to another game.

situations.title: {name} opens a pet repair desk
situations.body: Robot-pet owners can now pay for tune-ups at its repair desk, adding income beyond selling new pets.

situations.title: Pet tune-ups earn money for {name}
situations.body: Its new repair desk charges for robot-pet tune-ups, giving the company another way to earn money.

situations.title: {name} starts a sneaker service
situations.body: Owners can pay to have their jet sneakers cleaned and adjusted, bringing in money between new-pair sales.

situations.title: Sneaker servicing adds income at {name}
situations.body: A new paid cleaning and adjustment service gives jet-sneaker owners a reason to visit between purchases.

situations.title: {name} offers paid battery checks
situations.body: Tool owners can pay to have their super batteries checked, adding service income alongside battery sales.

situations.title: Battery check-ups earn fees for {name}
situations.body: Its new paid service checks how well super batteries are working, bringing in money from existing owners.

situations.title: {name}'s fizz demo draws a crowd
situations.body: A shop demonstration of its colour-changing fizzy drink drew a crowd, and more visitors bought a bottle.

situations.title: A drink demo brings buyers to {name}
situations.body: Shoppers stopped to watch its fizzy drink change colour, then bought bottles to try it themselves.

situations.title: {name}'s snack demo gets people talking
situations.body: A video showing its space snacks floating in a display has spread online, bringing new shoppers to stores.

situations.title: A snack video brings attention to {name}
situations.body: More people are visiting shops for its space snacks after watching a popular floating-snack demonstration.

situations.title: {name}'s game demo attracts players
situations.body: A video of players building a giant maze in its game is getting shared, and more viewers are buying it.

situations.title: A maze-building video helps {name} sell
situations.body: Viewers of a popular video want to build their own mazes in its video game, bringing in new sales.

situations.title: {name} adds a pet-tricks team
situations.body: New robot trainers are helping finish more pet tricks at once, getting a paid trick pack ready sooner.

situations.title: Extra trainers speed up {name}'s work
situations.body: Its new robot-training team can prepare pet tricks together, shortening work on a paid trick pack.

situations.title: {name} adds a sound team
situations.body: New sound designers can work on several game levels at once, helping the studio finish its next paid release.

situations.title: More sound designers join {name}
situations.body: An expanded sound team is finishing game music and effects faster, helping the next release stay on schedule.

situations.title: {name} adds a machine-repair team
situations.body: New repair technicians keep its battery-making machines running for longer, helping the factory fill more orders.

situations.title: Extra technicians help {name} keep working
situations.body: Its new machine-repair team reduces pauses on the super-battery line, leaving more time to fill orders.

situations.title: {name} pauses a batch of pets
situations.body: Some robot pets sit when asked to fetch. Fixing their commands is holding up deliveries.

situations.title: Mixed-up tricks hold up {name} pets
situations.body: A batch of robot pets follows the wrong commands. The company must fix them before sending them to shops.

situations.title: {name} holds back an update
situations.body: The new game menu keeps hiding the play button. Fixing it is delaying the paid expansion.

situations.title: {name} delays a game expansion
situations.body: Players cannot reach the play button in the new menu. The paid expansion must wait for a fix.

situations.title: {name} checks muddled sneaker controls
situations.body: A setting button on some jet sneakers selects the wrong mode, so the company is pausing deliveries for a fix.

situations.title: Wrong settings hold up {name} sneakers
situations.body: Some jet sneakers choose the wrong mode when their button is pressed. Fixing the controls is delaying orders.

situations.title: {name} waits for bottle caps
situations.body: A late shipment of bottle caps means fewer fizzy drinks can leave the factory this week.

situations.title: Missing caps slow {name} deliveries
situations.body: The factory has fizzy drinks ready but is still waiting for bottle caps, holding up this week's orders.

situations.title: {name} runs short of packets
situations.body: The factory has plenty of space snacks but too few packets, so some deliveries must wait.

situations.title: Too few packets hold up {name} snacks
situations.body: A shortage of empty packets is stopping the factory from packing all its space-snack orders.

situations.title: {name} waits for battery connectors
situations.body: A supplier has run short of connectors for its super batteries, leaving finished battery packs waiting for parts.

situations.title: Missing connectors delay {name} orders
situations.body: Its supplier cannot send enough battery connectors, so some super batteries cannot be finished for delivery.

situations.title: {name} repairs loose pet tails
situations.body: Some robot pets have loose tail joints. Fixing returned pets is costing the company extra money.

situations.title: Loose tails add costs for {name}
situations.body: The company is paying to repair tail joints on returned robot pets, adding an unexpected workshop bill.

situations.title: {name} checks squeaky sneakers
situations.body: A batch of jet sneakers squeaks with every step. Replacing the soles is adding repair costs.

situations.title: Squeaky soles cost {name} money
situations.body: The company is replacing noisy soles on a batch of jet sneakers, adding costs after the pairs were sold.

situations.title: {name} repairs battery handles
situations.body: Some super-battery carrying handles are coming loose. Replacing them is adding costs for the company.

situations.title: Loose handles bring a bill for {name}
situations.body: It is paying to replace handles on super batteries that customers already bought, increasing repair costs.

situations.title: {name} pets wait at the warehouse
situations.body: A delivery truck has broken down with robot-pet orders still at the warehouse, delaying sales to shops.

situations.title: A broken truck delays {name} pets
situations.body: Its robot pets cannot reach shops on time after a delivery truck broke down, pushing some sales back.

situations.title: {name} drinks miss their delivery slot
situations.body: A road closure has delayed its fizzy-drink trucks, so shops cannot get their orders for a busy weekend.

situations.title: Closed roads slow {name} deliveries
situations.body: Fizzy-drink orders are arriving late because trucks must take a longer route, leaving some shops short.

situations.title: {name} snacks miss a ferry
situations.body: A missed ferry has left space-snack orders at the port, delaying their arrival at island shops.

situations.title: A ferry delay holds up {name} snacks
situations.body: Boxes of space snacks are waiting for the next ferry, so island shops will get their orders later.

situations.title: {name} holds a batch of sneakers
situations.body: A batch of jet sneakers has uneven stitching. It must be checked again before the pairs can go to shops.

situations.title: Stitching checks slow {name} orders
situations.body: Inspectors found uneven seams on new jet sneakers, so the company is holding the batch for extra checks.

situations.title: {name} holds back soft snacks
situations.body: A batch of crunchy space snacks came out soft. The factory must remake it before filling the orders.

situations.title: A soft batch delays {name} snacks
situations.body: Its crunchy space snacks missed their usual crunch, so a replacement batch must be made for waiting shops.

situations.title: {name} checks short-running batteries
situations.body: A batch of super batteries ran for less time in factory tests. Extra checks are holding up the order.

situations.title: Battery tests delay {name} shipments
situations.body: New super batteries did not run long enough in testing, so the batch must stay at the factory for checks.

situations.title: {name} loses a cafe contract
situations.body: A cafe chain will stop buying its fizzy drinks next month, leaving the company with fewer regular orders.

situations.title: A cafe deal ends for {name}
situations.body: One cafe chain is dropping its fizzy drinks, taking away a stream of regular sales.

situations.title: {name} loses an arcade contract
situations.body: An arcade chain will stop paying to offer its video games, cutting the studio's regular fee income.

situations.title: An arcade deal ends for {name}
situations.body: A chain of arcades is removing its games and ending the payments it made to the studio each year.

situations.title: {name} loses a battery contract
situations.body: A garden-tool maker will stop ordering its super batteries, leaving a gap in the factory's regular business.

situations.title: A tool-maker deal ends for {name}
situations.body: One tool maker is ending its regular super-battery orders, giving the company fewer packs to sell.

situations.title: {name} faces a cheaper robot pet
situations.body: A rival has launched a lower-priced robot pet, and some shops are reducing their orders to try it.

situations.title: A rival pet competes with {name}
situations.body: Shops are making space for a cheaper robot pet from another company, ordering fewer of its pets.

situations.title: {name} faces a lighter rival sneaker
situations.body: A rival's new jet sneakers weigh less, and some shoppers are choosing them instead of its pairs.

situations.title: A lighter sneaker challenges {name}
situations.body: Another company has launched light jet sneakers that are winning over some of its usual customers.

situations.title: {name} faces a rival puzzle release
situations.body: A rival has released a new puzzle game, and players are spending less on its own puzzle adventures.

situations.title: A rival game draws players from {name}
situations.body: Some players are buying another studio's new puzzle game instead of its next adventure.

situations.title: {name} stops a filling line
situations.body: A broken pump has stopped one fizzy-drink filling line, reducing the number of bottles it can send to shops.

situations.title: A pump fault slows {name} bottling
situations.body: One filling line is waiting for a pump repair, so the factory is sending out fewer fizzy drinks.

situations.title: {name} stops a snack mixer
situations.body: A broken mixing machine is slowing space-snack production, leaving the factory behind on shop orders.

situations.title: A mixer repair delays {name} snacks
situations.body: The space-snack mixer needs repairs, cutting the amount the factory can make for waiting shops.

situations.title: {name} pauses a battery line
situations.body: A machine that joins super-battery parts has stopped working, reducing the number of packs the factory can finish.

situations.title: A broken machine slows {name} output
situations.body: The battery line is waiting for a joining-machine repair, leaving fewer super batteries ready to sell.

situations.title: {name} pets get low play scores
situations.body: Toy reviewers say its robot pets repeat too few tricks. Some shops are cutting orders after reading the reviews.

situations.title: Short trick lists hurt {name} reviews
situations.body: Reviews say its robot pets run through their tricks too quickly, and shops are ordering fewer pets.

situations.title: {name} snacks get low taste scores
situations.body: Food reviewers say a space-snack flavour tastes too salty. Shops are ordering fewer packs of that flavour.

situations.title: Salty snacks bring poor reviews for {name}
situations.body: Reviews of one space-snack flavour complain about too much salt, and shop orders for it are shrinking.

situations.title: {name} game gets low puzzle scores
situations.body: Game reviewers say its new puzzles feel too similar, and fewer players are buying the adventure.

situations.title: Repeated puzzles hurt {name}'s reviews
situations.body: Reviews say its video game repeats the same kinds of puzzle, putting some buyers off the game.

situations.title: {name} pays more for pet motors
situations.body: The small motors inside its robot pets now cost more, leaving less money from each pet sale.

situations.title: Costlier motors squeeze {name}
situations.body: A supplier has raised the price of robot-pet motors, making each new pet more expensive to build.

situations.title: {name} pays more for fruit flavour
situations.body: The fruit flavour used in its fizzy drinks costs more this month, raising the cost of each bottle.

situations.title: Flavour costs rise for {name}
situations.body: Its fizzy-drink flavour supplier has raised prices, leaving less money from each bottle sold.

situations.title: {name} pays more for sneaker fabric
situations.body: The tough fabric used in its jet sneakers now costs more, making each pair more expensive to produce.

situations.title: Fabric costs rise for {name}
situations.body: A higher price for sneaker fabric is adding to the cost of every pair of jet sneakers it makes.

situations.title: {name} loses a festival sales day
situations.body: An outdoor festival has been cancelled, leaving its drink stall without the crowd it expected to sell to.

situations.title: A cancelled festival cuts {name}'s sales
situations.body: Its fizzy-drink stall was stocked for a festival that will no longer take place, removing a day's sales.

situations.title: {name} loses a food-fair weekend
situations.body: A food fair has been cancelled, leaving its space-snack stand with stock but no visitors to sell to.

situations.title: A cancelled fair leaves {name} waiting
situations.body: Its space snacks were packed for a busy food fair, but the cancelled event means those sales will not happen.

situations.title: {name} loses a game-show weekend
situations.body: A games show has been cancelled, taking away a chance to demonstrate its video games and sell copies.

situations.title: A cancelled show costs {name} a sales chance
situations.body: The studio prepared a game demonstration for a show that will not run, losing its planned weekend of sales.

situations.title: {name} gets more sneaker returns
situations.body: More shoppers are returning jet sneakers after finding them heavier than expected, so the company is issuing refunds.

situations.title: Heavy sneakers bring refunds at {name}
situations.body: Shoppers who find its jet sneakers too heavy are sending pairs back, returning money the company had taken in.

situations.title: {name} sees more game refunds
situations.body: More buyers say its video game is shorter than they expected and are asking for their money back.

situations.title: Short play time brings refunds at {name}
situations.body: Players who expected a longer video game are requesting refunds, reducing the money kept from sales.

situations.title: {name} gets more battery returns
situations.body: Buyers say its super batteries take up too much room in their tool bags, and more are requesting refunds.

situations.title: Bulky batteries come back to {name}
situations.body: Some tool owners are returning super batteries that do not fit their bags, so the company must refund them.

situations.title: {name} takes longer to train new staff
situations.body: New workers need extra practice fitting robot-pet joints, so the factory is finishing fewer pets this week.

situations.title: Extra training slows {name}'s pet line
situations.body: Training new staff to fit robot-pet joints is taking longer than planned, leaving less time for this week's orders.

situations.title: {name} extends sneaker training
situations.body: New workers need more practice setting jet-sneaker straps, reducing the number of pairs finished this week.

situations.title: More training delays {name} pairs
situations.body: Extra strap-fitting lessons for new staff mean fewer jet sneakers are ready for this week's deliveries.

situations.title: {name} extends battery-test training
situations.body: New staff need more training on super-battery testing, slowing the checks that orders need before shipping.

situations.title: Training takes longer at {name}
situations.body: Its new battery testers need extra lessons, leaving fewer super-battery orders checked and ready to send.

situations.title: {name} sorts mixed-up drink labels
situations.body: A packing batch put the wrong flavour labels on fizzy drinks. Correcting them is delaying shop deliveries.

situations.title: Wrong labels hold up {name} drinks
situations.body: Its fizzy drinks need new labels after flavours were mixed up on the packing line, slowing deliveries.

situations.title: {name} sorts mixed-up snack boxes
situations.body: Snack boxes were packed with the wrong mix of flavours. Repacking them is adding work before they can ship.

situations.title: A box mix-up delays {name} snacks
situations.body: Its space-snack boxes contain the wrong flavour mix, so workers must repack them before sending orders.

situations.title: {name} fixes codes in game boxes
situations.body: Some boxed video games contain the wrong download code. Replacing the code cards is holding up deliveries.

situations.title: Wrong code cards delay {name} boxes
situations.body: Its game boxes need replacement download cards after a packing mix-up, delaying orders for shops.
